text: She's got the wind, she's got the flame,
Chasin' horizons, callin' her name.
Hey baby, she crossed the line —
No lookin' back, this dream is mine.
So she's got the spark, she's got the will,
Building her dream on the highest hill.
Says, "Hey world, don't hold me down —
I'll raise my heart above the ground."
I don't need no sorrow,
I don't need no crown,
I just need my steel and fire
to build this higher town.
I'm rising higher now,
She's got her hand in steel and light,
Drawin' her future through the endless night.
Says, Mother, can you hear me still,
I'm forging what the dawn fulfills.
I don't need no sorrow,
I don't need no crown,
I just need my steel and fire
to build this higher town.
I'm rising higher now,
Steel and fire in her hands,
Born from shadows, building light again.
Dreams like towers,
Rise through storms.
The sky keeps calling her name,
She won't fall down —
She was born to rise above,
Now she's reaching for the sun.
I don't need no sorrow,
I don't need no crown,
I just need my steel and fire
to build this higher town.
And I'm higher now,
I'm rising higher now.
